Slow & Steady Sundays

Norfolk, VA · Ghent · Social · Cruiser

No-dropBeginner friendlyUnconfirmed — check with the host

Slow & Steady Sundays is a social and cruiser group ride in Norfolk, VA. It rolls every Sunday at 10:30 am from Slow & Steady Bikes and Goods. About 8–12 miles, party pace, 8–12 mph. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 10:30 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 8–12 mph: you can talk the whole way. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Slow & Steady Sundays group ride

A casual party-pace ride from a small shop in Ghent. Eight to twelve miles at eight to twelve miles an hour. No drop, and the group waits if someone has a mechanical. Swing by early to see the shop. The Downtown Norfolk listing last showed dates through December 2025, so confirm with the shop before you go.
